description:
Add the reusable gf2-core operation deriving an element of exact multiplicative order $n$ in an extension field, with deterministic canonical selection.

## Background

`Gf2mField::primitive_element` requires tables and there is no generic exact-order constructor. Non-primitive BCH lengths need an order-$n$ root of unity, and reproducibility requires that the same field and $n$ select the same element deterministically, not merely some element.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: gf2-core derives an element of exact multiplicative order $n$ for supported extension fields, validating the order exactly, with a documented deterministic canonical selection rule.
- [hard] REQ-02: A typed error reports the case where no order-$n$ element exists, and property tests cover order exactness plus selection determinism over binary and nonbinary fields.
title: Deterministic derivation of elements with exact multiplicative order
